format.description: Format id of the input file.

acquisition.description:
Present when the file is not finished: still being written (`in_progress`) or
stopped before the end (`interrupted`). See `book/src/guides/lab-shares.md`.

LsEntry.description: One row of `info --view structure`: a structural element of the container.

name.description: Element name (an id, a chunk name or a path inside the container).

offset.description: Byte offset of the element in the file, when it has one.

size.description: Size of the element in bytes, when known.

image.description: Which image this element belongs to, if any.

Acquisition.description:
`acquisition` in `info`, `info --view structure`, `check` and `planes`: present only for
files that are not finished. See `book/src/guides/lab-shares.md`.

complete_planes.description: Planes whose data is entirely on disk.

expected_planes.description: Planes the finished file will hold, when the metadata written so far says so.

modified_ago_s.description: Seconds since the file (or the newest member of a directory store) was modified.

window_s.description: The live window used for the decision, in seconds.

missing.description: Structures written at the end of an acquisition that are absent.

tail_bytes.description: Bytes after the last complete unit (a unit still being written).

AcquisitionState.description: Whether an incomplete file is still being written.

oneOf.description: Recently modified and missing only what is written last: still acquiring.

Missing what is written last, but unchanged for longer than the live window: the
acquisition (or a copy) stopped before the end.
